sections.title: Letter sound esse
paragraphs: The letter name is (esse) /ˈɛsse/. Its main sound is a voiceless consonant in (sera) /ˈse.ra/, which means evening. Voiceless means your throat does not shake. This letter has two sounds.

sections.title: Saying the letter
paragraphs: Bring the tip of your tongue near the ridge behind your upper teeth. Push air through the narrow gap to make a sharp hiss. Do not use your voice. For the other sound, keep the same mouth shape, but turn your voice on. Touch your throat to feel it shake.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: You make the voiceless sound at the start of a word before a vowel, as in (sole) /ˈso.le/. You also use it next to a voiceless consonant, as in (testa) /ˈtɛ.sta/. The voiced sound appears before a voiced consonant, heard in (sbaglio) /ˈzbaʎ.ʎo/. You also say the voiced sound between vowels in northern speech, heard in (rosa) /ˈrɔ.za/.

sections.title: Avoiding mistakes
paragraphs: Do not turn the voiceless sound into a voiced buzz at the start of words. Keep your voice quiet, like the first sound in sun. When this consonant comes before a voiced letter, do turn your voice on. Make it buzz like the first sound in zoo.
